$comment: Every category the sample church adds to Rock, in one tree per kind of thing it holds (decision 185). The church's own data views live under one parent, Rock Solid Church, with a child for each purpose, so they never mix with the views Rock ships. Add a child here (for example Communications, Care, or Reporting) before adding data views for a new purpose. Communication list categories stay flat, like Rock's own Public category. 'entityType' is the Rock entity the category holds. 'qualifierGroupType' limits a Group category to one group type, the way Rock's category picker on Communication Lists does. 'parent' is another category's key. Categories always load, with the church setup. A category can carry 'security': for each action, the Rock roles allowed (Rock's role names, mapped to Guids in security-roles.json) and whether All Users are denied after them, written as Rock's security editor saves them. Data views and reports inherit their category's security (decision D-reporting-1). 'rockShips' marks a category Rock ships: the loader finds it by Guid and changes only its name and description.

categories.name: Rock Solid Church
categories.description: The church's own data views. Each child category holds the views for one purpose.

categories.name: Foundations
categories.description: The shared rules every other church view builds on: who is active, who is an adult, who comes regularly, who is in a group, and who serves. Each holds one idea.

categories.name: Path
categories.description: The Ministry by Design stages, built from steps: who has reached each stage of the path. A person can be in more than one.

categories.name: Notice
categories.description: First contact: guests who are new or coming back, before they belong.

categories.name: Belong
categories.description: Connection: who belongs, and who is ready to belong.

categories.name: Equip
categories.description: Discipleship: who is growing, and who is ready for a next step such as Foundations or baptism.

categories.name: Contribute
categories.description: Engagement: who takes part in the church's mission, and who is ready to serve.

categories.name: Lead
categories.description: Leadership development: who leads, and who is ready to lead.

categories.name: Re-engage
categories.description: Retention: people who have stopped coming, so someone can reach out.

categories.name: Group Sync
categories.description: Data views that keep a communication list or security role in sync through Rock's Group Sync job.

categories.name: Registrations
categories.description: Data views about event registrations: who has registered, who has not, and who may register.

categories.name: Sample Data
categories.description: Views that exist only because this is sample data. The flows send only to people with a reserved email or none, so no message reaches a real staff address. A real church would not need these.

categories.name: Safety
categories.description: Background checks and the kids allergy list. Only Safety & Security Workers, Background Check Administration, and Rock Administration can see them.

categories.name: Finance
categories.description: Giving and pledge data views. Only the finance roles and Rock Administration can see them, and only Finance Administration can edit them.

categories.name: Staff Workspace
categories.description: A place where any staff member can build their own data views. The other church categories are kept by Rock Administration.

categories.name: Foundational Views (Shipped)
categories.description: The data views Rock ships as examples. The church's own foundations are in Rock Solid Church > Foundations.

categories.name: Rock Solid Church
categories.description: The church's own reports. Each child category holds the reports for one part of the path.

categories.name: Leadership
categories.description: Reports for the pastors: the whole path, and who to thank. Only Pastoral Workers and Rock Administration can see them.

categories.name: Notice
categories.description: Reports on first contact: guests who are new or coming back.

categories.name: Belong
categories.description: Reports on connection: who belongs, and who is ready to belong.

categories.name: Equip
categories.description: Reports on discipleship: who is growing, and who is ready for a next step.

categories.name: Contribute
categories.description: Reports on engagement: who is ready to serve.

categories.name: Lead
categories.description: Reports on leadership development: who is ready to lead.

categories.name: Re-engage
categories.description: Reports on people who have stopped coming.

categories.name: Safety
categories.description: Background check and allergy reports. Only Safety & Security Workers, Background Check Administration, and Rock Administration can see them.

categories.name: Finance
categories.description: Giving and pledge reports. Only the finance roles and Rock Administration can see them, and only Finance Administration can edit them.

categories.name: Staff Workspace
categories.description: A place where any staff member can build their own reports. The other church categories are kept by Rock Administration.

categories.name: Care
categories.description: Private lists staff use to follow up with people, such as first-time guests and people who have not been back in a while.

categories.name: Staff
categories.description: What the church shows about each staff member, such as on a staff page: their staff photo, title, department, campus, bio, and favorite quote, plus their supervisor and start date for staff only.
